name: sih-cyber-threat-detection
description: AI-Based Detection of Cyber Threats in Unidirectional IP Traffic

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const vendorDir = path.join('dashboard', 'vendor'); if (!fs.existsSync(vendorDir)) fs.mkdirSync(vendorDir, { recursive: true }); const chartSrc = path.join('node_modules', 'chart.js', 'dist', 'chart.umd.js'); if (fs.existsSync(chartSrc)) { fs.copyFileSync(chartSrc, path.join(vendorDir, 'chart.umd.js')); console.log('  Vendor: copied Chart.js to dashboard/vendor/chart.umd.js'); } const files = ['dashboard/index.html', 'dashboard/style.css', 'dashboard/app.js']; files.forEach(f => { if (!fs.existsSync(f)) throw new Error('Missing ' + f); console.log('  Verified: ' + f + ' (' + fs.statSync(f).size + ' bytes)'); }); console.log('Build completed successfully.');"
scripts.test: npm run build && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'

author: SIH Team
